name: @zhushanwen/z-subagent-workflow
description: Subagent orchestration + deterministic multi-phase workflows for zcode via the zsw CLI (pure local one-shot processes since 2.0.0 — no resident daemon): subagent lifecycle with worktree isolation, schema outputs, model routing, core-unified agent .md discovery (vendored built-in roles + user roots, absolute-path agent refs shared with the pi platform), and built-in workflows (chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop) with custom core-contract scripts referenced by absolute .js path — including the script-generate/lint/save/delete creative loop. Long tasks are carried by Bash run_in_background (completion rides engine-native task-notification), no polling.
author: zhushanwen (https://github.com/zhushanwen321)
